fedimintcard Experimental prototype

Fedimint ecash on a card.

Fedimint Card is an experimental JavaCard applet. The card holds the spend keys for Fedimint ecash notes and signs each spend itself when you tap it at a till.

See it work

The Fedi app loads the card, the card pays a till by tap, and the federation returns the change.

How a payment works

The card does one job: it signs with keys that were made on its chip. The till and the federation do everything else.

  1. Load the card

    Ecash from a Fedimint wallet is reissued to keys the card generated on its own chip. The federation issues the new notes to those keys.

  2. Tap at the till

    The till builds the transaction and the card signs it with the note's key. The card sees only the 32-byte transaction hash.

  3. The federation settles

    The guardians check the signature and mark the note spent. Change goes back to keys on the card in the same transaction.

Risks to know

Fedimint Card is an experimental prototype, and its applet and till code have had no outside security review. Keep only small amounts on a card, amounts you can afford to lose.

  • The federation holds the bitcoin.Fedimint ecash is a claim on one federation. If enough of its guardians fail or act together against you, the ecash loses its value.
  • A lost card can lose its ecash.In today's prototype the spend keys are made on the card and live only there. The planned design lets the owner's phone sweep a lost card.
  • The prototype has no PIN or spending limits.Any reader that reaches the card can ask it to sign, or replace a note key, which strands the note. PINs and limits that cap what a skimmer can do are planned.
  • Check the amount on the till.The till shows the amount and builds the payment, as with any card. Pay only at tills you trust.
  • The till needs a connection.The federation checks each payment as it happens, so a till that cannot reach it cannot take a tap.
  • The Fedi app does not load cards yet.The film shows how loading is meant to work. Today a separate wallet on a computer loads the card.
